[SWS_SM_00623] ActionListItem "Start StateMachine" - with parameter, StateMa-
chine is already running
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
When the
ActionListItem
"Start StateMachine" is processed, and the referenced
StateMachine
is already started, the
StateMachine
shall transition to the state,
which is provided as parameter.
⌋
